scientific_scope: Authoritative or primary-source leads for additional IN625 LPBF physical evidence that are not yet promoted into the ingestion-ready source registry. Frontier inclusion is discovery state only.

candidates.machine: three LPBF machines; row-level machine identity must be taken from the authoritative workbook and retained
candidates.material: IN625 and IN718 bare plates; IN625 subset is relevant to this frontier

repository_metadata_interface.download_contract: nrdp:DataFile + nrdp:DownloadableFile component with downloadURL, size, and SHA-256 checksum

promotion_requirements: Acquire exact NERDm metadata plus README/workbook bytes and verify NIST-published SHA-256 and size.
Audit workbook Data and Summary sheets before creating row-level scientific records.
Preserve machine, programmed-power/calibration semantics, spot diameter, plate/track identity, and repeated-measurement structure.
Acquire only relevant raw micrographs after workbook identity mapping is established; do not bulk-download images by filename guess.
Keep AMMT, EOS M270, and EOS M290 evidence machine-stratified and do not relabel programmed power as AMMT calibrated actual power.

candidates.digest_support: NIST/Data.gov publishes .sha256 sidecars for the downloadable files.
promotion_requirements: Acquire exact bytes plus NIST-published SHA-256 sidecar.
Audit workbook rows and camera/temperature semantics.
Split bare and powder records before ingestion.
Use response-specific contracts; do not treat thermographic length as cross-sectional width/depth.
Retain EOS M270 machine identity and commercial-machine power semantics.

candidates.machine: AMB2018-02 commercial build machine (modified EOS M270)
promotion_requirements: Bind file bytes and checksums/version metadata.
Bind track-level replication from the NIST dataset structures.
Keep CBM and AMMT as separate machines and calibration semantics.
Use thermographic response definitions rather than cross-sectional geometry assumptions.

candidates.material: virgin EOS Nickel alloy 625 powder, lot M341901

measurement_semantics.height: largest vertical distance including material above and below the original top surface

promotion_requirements: Resolve the Table 1 1200 mm/s versus Results/Table 2/Figures 1500 mm/s inconsistency from an authoritative correction, raw build file, or author response.
Acquire row-level track measurements with build position, scan direction, sample type, and failure/no-track state.
Preserve melt_pool_height as distinct from bare-plate melt_pool_depth.
Preserve zero/no-track observations as censor/failure states rather than silently dropping them.
Retain EOS M290, powder-on-built-surface state, gas-flow location, and scan direction as explicit factors.

candidates.authority: Science and Technology of Advanced Materials / ORNL-associated authors
promotion_requirements: Extract or acquire row-level 175-case Alloy 625 matrix from an authoritative author/supplement source.
Do not assume the listed parameter levels form a Cartesian product.
Bind track identity and independent-replication semantics.
Retain Concept Laser M2, powder state, beam diameter, and layer thickness as explicit model factors.
Locate author-controlled or institutional raw image dataset.
Establish image-to-run/track/process-condition provenance.
Audit label generation and parent-disjoint train/test semantics.
Do not infer AMB2018-02 Stage 1 geometry evidence from image-classification use.
